description: Read-only review of skill knowledge, routing and eval evidence without UI implementation or authority escalation.

stages.purpose: Inspect current skill owners and reproduce knowledge or routing failures without target mutation.

gates.require: Source, scope, non-mutation and evidence boundaries are explicit
